legend: Consider a system of n water taps all pouring water into the same container. The i-th water tap can be set to deliver any amount of water from 0 to ai ml per second (this amount may be a real number). The water delivered by i-th tap has temperature ti.

If for every ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29cd41d3b7a01103f80f7f1a061fdf146ffa49b1.png) you set i-th tap to deliver exactly xi ml of water per second, then the resulting temperature of water will be ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/80ff149d627e36b02eb3a7af6ef4c83c177753f1.png) (if ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3732be77fa6132294370a6abded03dbe6bec83a.png), then to avoid division by zero we state that the resulting water temperature is 0).
You have to set all the water taps in such a way that the resulting temperature is exactly T. What is the maximum amount of water you may get per second if its temperature has to be T?
input: The first line contains two integers n and T (1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ T ≤ 106) — the number of water taps and the desired temperature of water, respectively.
The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 106) where ai is the maximum amount of water i-th tap can deliver per second.
The third line contains n integers t1, t2, ..., tn (1 ≤ ti ≤ 106) — the temperature of water each tap delivers.
output: Print the maximum possible amount of water with temperature exactly T you can get per second (if it is impossible to obtain water with such temperature, then the answer is considered to be 0).
Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed 10 - 6.

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 T（1 ≤ n ≤ 200000，1 ≤ T ≤ 106），分别表示水龙头的数量和期望的水温。
第二行包含 n 个整数 a1、a2、...、an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 106），其中 ai 表示第 i 个水龙头每秒能够输送的最大水量。
第三行包含 n 个整数 t1, t2, ..., tn（1 ≤ ti ≤ 10^6）——每个水龙头流出的水的温度。

output.ai: 输出每秒你能获得的温度恰好为 T 的水的最大可能数量（如果无法获得该温度的水，则答案视为 0）。
如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10^-6，则视为正确。

legend.ai: 考虑有 n 个水龙头都向同一个容器中注水。第 i 个水龙头可以设置为每秒输送 0 到 ai 毫升的任意水量（该水量可以是实数）。第 i 个水龙头输送的水温为 ti。

如果对于每个 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29cd41d3b7a01103f80f7f1a061fdf146ffa49b1.png)，将第 i 个水龙头设置为每秒输送恰好 xi 毫升的水，那么最终水的温度将为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/80ff149d627e36b02eb3a7af6ef4c83c177753f1.png)(如果 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3732be77fa6132294370a6abded03dbe6bec83a.png)，则为避免除以零，我们规定最终水温为 0)。
你需要设置所有水龙头，使最终水温恰好为 T。如果水温必须为 T，那么每秒最多可以得到多少水？
